preview.title: Screenshots of the app
preview.sub: agnts started the app with this change and took screenshots. Advice only: it never blocks approval.
preview.pending: Queued: agnts takes screenshots as soon as a worker is free.
preview.running: agnts is starting the app and taking screenshots…
preview.failed: The preview run failed. Check the run log, or run it again.
preview.stale: These screenshots are of revision {n}; the change moved on since.
preview.model: {n, plural, =0 {No screenshots} one {# screenshot} other {# screenshots}} by {model}
preview.withBase: with the default branch for comparison
preview.slider: Drag to compare before and after
preview.consoleErrors: {count, plural, one {# console error} other {# console errors}}
preview.noBefore: No before screenshot: this page is new or could not open on the default branch.
preview.tooMany: Feedback can carry {n} screenshots at most.
preview.repoHelp: How agnts starts the app to take screenshots of UI changes before you review them. Leave the command empty to turn previews off.
preview.repoCommandHelp: Runs in /workspace inside the run container: install, build and start the dev server. It must listen on the port below.
preview.repoUiPathsHelp: One glob per line, relative to the repository root. A change touching one gets screenshots. Empty: every change.
preview.repoRoutesHelp: Routes captured on every preview, one per line, besides the ones agnts picks from the diff.
preview.repoLoginPh: Sign in as demo@acme.test; the password is in PREVIEW_PASSWORD.
preview.repoLoginHelp: Tell agnts how to get past a login, if the app has one. Refer to secrets by variable name.
preview.repoEnvSet: Set: {names}. The values are never shown.
preview.repoEnvCleared: The environment will be cleared when you save.
preview.repoEnvHelp: KEY=value lines given to the app, such as a staging API URL. Stored encrypted and never shown again. Use staging-only credentials: the app and agnts can read them. Add any host the app calls to Settings → Previews → Allowed hosts.
preview.settingsSub: Screenshots of UI changes, for repositories with a preview command.
preview.autoPreview: Take screenshots of every UI change
preview.autoPreviewHelp: While a change waits for you, agnts starts the app, opens the pages it touches and shows screenshots next to the diff. It never blocks approval.
preview.visualCheck: Let coding runs look at the app
preview.visualCheckHelp: {agent} may start the app and look at the pages it changed before it finishes, and fix what looks broken. Costs a few more turns.
preview.modelHelp: Picks the pages and judges the screenshots.
preview.egressHelp: Hosts run containers may reach besides the built-in list ({agent}, git hosts, package registries), such as a staging API your app calls in a preview. .example.com allows its subdomains.
preview.notifyPhotosHelp: Up to four screenshots go with the Telegram message.
